s1.desc: a living room drawn on a plain pale grey background

beats.text: Pax lies along the sofa snuggled against Polly with his eyes closed and blushing cheeks, while Polly holds him and little hearts float up
Polly pulls out {ifin} and raises it high in one flipper while Pax stays snuggled against her with his eyes closed

spans.notes: camera locked: sofa-front band 1.000, <=0.2 px at cc 1.000 (texture 2.6%/4.2%); compare 0/54 sofa edges overlap (the higher band's drift was Pax's feet). Phone: pale grey back, three lenses, tuft on top = iFin. No overlay
phone point of view: the iFin's camera screen with its UI shows Pax and Polly taking selfies (lead on a screen = lead_copy)

Pax and Polly sitting on the sofa, Polly lowering the phone: 5 locked frames f98-102, a pull-back f103-114 that reveals a door and a glass table, then 7 locked frames in which Pax hops off the sofa. No piece reaches 21 frames

spans.view: with the arm of a cream sofa beside him

beats.text: Pax drops down beside the sofa and lands on his feet with a frown
Pax hops up and down beside the sofa with his flippers raised like fists and a fierce frown
Pax lunges forward and throws punches to the right with his eyes squeezed shut
Pax raises his flippers like fists again and stands frowning with a determined look

spans.notes: camera locked: compare 122/127 and 127/166 sofa edges overlap exactly (keep12 is low because Pax fills the picture and moves; the motion band touched Pax). A cut to a new angle of the sofa at f167. No overlay

19 frames to the end: Polly bounces on the sofa with the phone while Pax stands in front of it
